theorems.name: Submission.dpf_exists_orthonormal_frame_det_gram
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ v → ∃ σ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ σ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (σ i) (v j)) ^ 2 ∧ Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (σ i) (v j)) ≠ 0 ∧ |Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (σ i) (v j))| ≤ ∏ i, ‖v i‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
